_comment: Parseable dev runtime-config SSOT (Phase 0, 2026-05-29). The dev origins (apiBaseUrl / wsBaseUrl / oidcIssuer ...) live here ONCE so the dev CSP helper (vite/dev-csp.ts) can derive connect-src via new URL(...).origin WITHOUT eval-ing or re-hardcoding public/runtime-config.js. The browser-served dev stub public/runtime-config.js is sealed against this file's origin values by tests/test_apps_web_scaffold.py::TestDevCspSeparation (cross-source drift guard). DEV GATEWAY (fe-dev-gateway-proxy, 2026-06-14): apiBaseUrl/wsBaseUrl point at the Vite dev origin (localhost:5173), NOT the backends — vite.config.ts server.proxy path-routes /session (ws) -> :8000, /headless -> :8001, /platform -> :8002 (env-overridable), mirroring the prod single-gateway path-routed topology so all three ASGI apps are reachable same-origin (no CORS). Non-secret — frontend is a public client; NEVER put secrets here.
